meta_description: Howells Gardening Services in Sheffield offers professional garden maintenance, design and landscaping. Local, reliable, and fully insured. Call 07437 864689 for a free quote.
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to garden design, Howells Gardening transforms your outdoor space into somewhere you'll actually want to spend time.
services_subhead: Whether you need weekly maintenance, a complete garden overhaul, or professional design advice, we handle it all to the highest standard.

services.title: Garden Maintenance & Lawn Care
services.desc: Regular cutting, edging, and seasonal care keep your garden looking sharp year-round. We handle borders, hedges, and pathways so you don't have to.

services.title: Garden Design & Landscaping
services.desc: Transform an overgrown mess into a usable outdoor space. We design, plan, and build patios, raised beds, pergolas, and feature planting.

services.title: Hedge & Shrub Trimming
services.desc: Neat, professional pruning and shaping. We keep boundaries tidy and encourage healthy growth, collected and disposed of responsibly.

services.title: Fence & Trellis Installation
services.desc: New fences, repairs, and trellis work that adds security and structure to your garden. We use quality materials and solid craftsmanship.

services.title: Garden Clearance & Waste Removal
services.desc: Reclaim your space from overgrown jungle. We clear, dig out, and haul away all waste — nothing left behind except a tidy garden.

services.title: Planting & Seasonal Preparation
services.desc: Expert planting advice and execution. Spring beds, autumn tidy-ups, and seasonal colour schemes tailored to your soil and light.

about_pullquote: I started this business because I wanted gardening done the right way, at fair prices.
about_para_1: Howells Gardening Services has been looking after Sheffield gardens for over 15 years. We started with a simple aim: to offer honest, skilled gardening work at prices that don't sting. Today we've transformed hundreds of gardens across Sheffield, from small town terraces to large country properties. Every job gets the same care and attention — we don't rush, and we clean up after ourselves.
about_para_2: Customers keep us busy because we show up on time, do what we promise, and treat your garden like it matters. Whether it's a quick trim or a full redesign, we listen to what you want and deliver without fuss. Many of our clients have been with us for years — that loyalty means everything to us.
reviews_heading: What Sheffield Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a terrible overgrown garden that I didn't know where to start with. Craig came round, talked through what I wanted, and cracked on with it. The transformation is unreal. Really tidy work, fair price, and he cleaned up properly afterwards. Absolutely chuffed.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Been using Howells for regular maintenance for about three years now. Reliable, professional, and always turns up when he says he will. The garden looks immaculate. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: Jennifer K.

reviews.text: Needed the fence sorting and some hedges tidied before we sold the house. Got the job done quickly without cutting corners. Buyer's surveyor didn't have a word to say about it. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: Andrew L.
